title: $6,853 in Weekly Options Income from Selling Puts and Calls: August 10-14 Review & Case Studies

macro.label: VIX
macro.text: Opened 15.46 Monday, closed 14.25 Friday, the week's low.

callouts.headline: Roll chain from $135 to $116 closed keeping ~97% of premium
callouts.body: Walked the strike down three times as ALB fell, then the stock reversed and both final legs closed near max profit.

callouts.headline: Defensive roll on a call pushed past 0.60 delta
callouts.body: Rolled out and up for a net credit, moving the strike from $97 to $115 despite booking a $263 loss on the closed leg.

callouts.headline: Covered call finished in the money, shares called away at $135
callouts.body: Stock closed well above the strike at expiry; the $297 premium is kept regardless.

callouts.headline: Second ALB position headed for assignment on the $160 put
callouts.body: Deep in the money with days left; cost basis after premium works out to roughly $144/share once assigned.
